bias.en: Bearish · oversold, closed under the $58.4 April low
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，收盘跌破 4 月低点 $58.4

read.en: Intel fell 3.8% on Nov 4 to $58.27, trading between $56.77 and $60.20 on heavy volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($67.3), 10-day ($78.9), 30-day ($98.3) and 100-day ($103.1) averages and the rising 200-day ($87.0). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($92.24), and RSI is 22.8, the lowest in 20 sessions.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月4日下跌 3.8%，收于 $58.27，盘中区间 $56.77–60.20，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$67.3）、10 日（$78.9）、30 日（$98.3）和 100 日均线（$103.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$87.0）下方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$92.24），RSI 为 22.8，为 20 个交易日最低。

read.en: The close broke the $58.4–59.9 support (Apr 9 low, Nov 2–3 lows), now resistance with the $60.2 high. Resistance is $58.4–60.2, then $60.75–62.6 (April lows, Nov 3 high) and $63.2–65.7. Support is $56.8 (Nov 4 low), then $54.8 (Apr 8 low) and $49.9–50. A close above $60.2 would target $62–62.6; below $56.8, $54.8.
